title: Principal Architect
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

  • Assumir o desafio de desenvolver uma carteira de clientes própria, partindo do zero, com ênfase em estabelecer parcerias sólidas e estratégicas por meio de prospecção ativa, relacionamento e abordagem consultiva;
  • Prospecção ativa e gerenciamento de carteira de clientes que venha a constituir, com empresas de faturamento a partir de R$ 30 milhões/ano, especialmente em operações de crédito e estruturadas;
  • Apresentação de soluções bancárias personalizadas, agregando valor único e construindo conexões duradouras;
  • Negociação de produtos e serviços especializados no mercado de alto valor, com foco em capital de giro, conta garantida, desconto de duplicatas, trade finance, leasing, e estruturação de dívidas;
  • Apresentação de soluções bancárias, adicionando valor único a cada relacionamento.

Requisitos e Qualificações que Elevam:

  • Carteira de clientes com faturamento superior a R$ 30 milhões/ano;
  • Formação superior completa;
  • Amplo conhecimento em produtos e serviços bancários, com visão além dos números;
  • Experiência comprovada em instituição financeira, trazendo não só expertise, mas paixão;
  • Atuação dinâmica em diversas praças e segmentos, alimentando a diversidade de perspectivas;
  • Habilidade excepcional em análise de crédito e balanços, enxergando oportunidades onde outros veem desafios, visão a longo prazo;
  • Certificação ativa ANBIMA - Série 10, construindo credibilidade desde o primeiro contato;
  • Veículo próprio para visitas.

Informações adicionais

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.

Benefícios que Valorizam Você:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Cobertura completa para cuidados médicos e odontológicos de qualidade;
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Creche: Apoio financeiro para conciliar trabalho e responsabilidades familiares;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados (PLR): Reconhecimento financeiro pelo seu empenho e contribuição para o sucesso da empresa;
  • Programa de Participação de Resultados: Incentivo contínuo para o alcance de metas individuais e coletivas;
  • Apoio à Educação: Suporte para desenvolvimento acadêmico e profissional, investindo no seu desenvolvimento;
  • Parcerias com Desconto: Vantagens exclusivas em uma variedade de produtos e serviços por meio de parcerias estratégicas;
  • Dia Livre: Flexibilidade com um dia livre para recarregar energias e equilibrar responsabilidades;
  • Totalpass - Incentivo à Saúde: Acesso a uma ampla rede de atividades físicas, promovendo um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.

title: Tax Sr Analyst (Advanced English)
description:
Join Our Team as Tax Sr Analyst – Brazil (São Paulo) Advanced English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Department: Finance LATAM

Are you a seasoned tax professional ready to lead and make an impact in a global organization? We’re looking for a Tax Sr Analyst to oversee tax compliance and strategic initiatives for our Brazilian entity. This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your expertise will shape tax operations and support business growth.

What You’ll Do

As Tax Sr Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading tax compliance for direct and indirect taxes in Brazil.
  • Preparing tax calculations for review by external advisors (EY, Deloitte).
  • Managing deferred tax accounting (IFRS and BRGAAP), including annual and half-year calculations.
  • Overseeing reconciliations for tax GL accounts using SAP and Blackline.
  • Coordinating SPED, municipal obligations (withholding tax), IBGE, and BACEN reporting.
  • Supporting Transfer Pricing processes with external specialists.
  • Advising internal teams on tax treatment for various operations.
  • Staying ahead of regulatory changes, including Brazil’s ongoing Tax Reform.
  • Collaborating with external auditors and tax authorities during audits.
  • Leading a team of 3 direct reports and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in Brazilian tax (local & international), tax accounting, and compliance.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting or Tax.
  • Technical Skills: SAP, SPED, HFM (BRACS), Blackline.
  • Tax Expertise: IRPJ, CSLL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, ICMS; knowledge of tax treaties and audit processes.
  • Languages: Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical mindset, team leadership, and collaboration.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with a strong presence in LATAM.
  • Lead impactful tax projects and contribute to strategic decisions.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for development and innovation.

  • Previdência Privada;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.

Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.

Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoa com Deficiência - PcD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (03 dias presenciais, 02 home office);
  • Horário de trabalho: de segunda a sexta-feira, comercial flexível;
  • Local de trabalho: Jardins, próximo ao metrô Consolação - Av. Paulista;
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente online nas etapas iniciais.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields

EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

title: Audio Producer
description:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

title: Technical Service Engineer - Building Materials (Mortar Powder & Coatings)
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Technical Service Engineer to provide expert technical support and solutions for our Mortar Powder & building material coatings product lines. This role combines hands-on field troubleshooting, customer training, and collaboration with R&D to optimize product performance and ensure customer satisfaction in construction, industrial, and architectural markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customers, distributors, and sales teams, resolving issues related to product application, performance, and compatibility (e.g., adhesion failure, curing defects, durability concerns).
  • Conduct on-site visits to diagnose problems and recommend solutions for Mortar Powder (e.g., concrete additives, mortar mixes) and coatings (e.g., epoxy, waterproofing, decorative finishes).
  • Product Training & Documentation
  • Develop and deliver technical training programs for customers, contractors, and internal teams on product usage, safety protocols, and best practices.
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including application guides, safety data sheets (SDS), and troubleshooting manuals.
  • Product Optimization & Testing
  • Collaborate with R&D and QA teams to improve product formulations based on field feedback and performance data.
  • Perform lab and field tests to validate product compatibility with substrates (concrete, wood, metal) and environmental conditions (humidity, temperature).
  • Compliance & Sustainability
  • Ensure products meet industry standards (e.g., ISO, ASTM) and environmental regulations (e.g., low VOC, REACH compliance).
  • Advocate for sustainable solutions, such as eco-friendly coatings or recycled sand powder applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Support sales teams by participating in client meetings, demonstrating product value, and addressing technical inquiries during pre- and post-sales phases.
  • Work with supply chain to address logistics or raw material challenges impacting product performance.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., NACE, SSPC) are a plus. 3+ years of experience in technical service, R&D, or application engineering within the building materials, coatings, or construction chemicals industry. Sherwin williams,Sika,etc are preferred.

Required Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of Mortar Powder applications (e.g., cementitious systems) and coating technologies (e.g., epoxy, polyurethane, acrylic).
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methods, data analysis, and root-cause analysis for product failures.
  • Familiarity with CAD software, simulation tools, or digital tools for technical documentation is advantageous.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with green building certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM).
  • Multilingual skills for roles supporting global markets (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin).
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer site visits and industry events.

description:
TÍTULO: ESTE CONVITE É PARA VOCÊ, PESSOA VENDEDORA DE CALÇADOS!

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

Se você tem talento para atendimento, entende de modelo, grade e conforto que cada calçado pode oferecer para os nossos pés, seu lugar é aqui! Você vai ajudar os nossos clientes a encontrarem o calçado perfeito, com toda a sua paixão pelo esporte e conhecimento das últimas tecnologias.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Saber mostrar o que temos de melhor em calçados, de acordo com as necessidades e especificações de cada cliente, além de destacar as tecnologias disponíveis no mercado.
  • Dar aquele show de conhecimento para os nossos clientes, com muita energia e disposição.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Pra jogar bonito, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Experiência com vendas e/ou atendimento
  • Conhecimento em calçados é considerado um diferencial.

SOBRE A CENTAURO

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quand

o chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado, afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Java Stack)
description:
We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused On-Site Technical Support Engineer to provide technical expertise for our financial services products, with a focus on credit industry solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong Java development skills, hands-on experience with MySQL, and a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in real-time. A background in the credit/banking industry and exceptional client communication skills are essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support for the financial systems, ensuring minimal downtime and rapid resolution of issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve problems related to Java applications, Redis caching, MySQL databases, and associated middleware.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement preventive measures.

System Maintenance & Optimization

  • Monitor system performance, conduct regular health checks, and optimize configurations for Redis, MySQL, and Java applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to deploy patches, updates, and hotfixes in production environments.

Client Communication & Requirements Handling

  • Act as the primary technical liaison between clients and the Chinese teams, transmitting business needs to technical solution arthitect in China.
  • Respond promptly to client operational requests, prioritize tasks, and manage expectations effectively.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Create detailed technical documentation, including incident reports, troubleshooting guides, and best practices.
  • Train clients on system functionalities and operational workflows.

Compliance & Collaboration

  • Ensure solutions adhere to local credit industry regulations (e.g., data security, audit requirements).
  • Work closely with DevOps, QA, and product teams to improve system reliability and user experience.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Java development and debugging (Spring Boot, J2EE, or similar frameworks).
  • Strong experience with MySQL (query optimization, replication, backup/recovery).
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Linux/Unix environments, and scripting (Shell/Python).
  • Knowledge of DevOps tools (Jenkins, Docker) and monitoring systems (Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Redis (cluster management, performance tuning) is a plus.

Industry Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support or development roles, preferably within the credit, banking, or fintech sectors.
  • Understanding of credit business processes (e.g., loan management, risk assessment, payment systems).

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel frequently for on-site client support.

Language

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in Java, Redis, MySQL, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
  • Experience with microservices architecture and cloud-native technologies.
  • Knowledge of financial compliance standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR).
  • Knowledge of credit risk management systems(e.g., FICO, Neurotech).

title: Logistics & Partner Operations Trainee
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage the onboarding of 3PL (third-party logistics) partners from start to finish.
  • Coordinate compliance checks and make sure all partner documents (e.g. CNPJ, tax records, bank details) meet legal and financial requirements.
  • Work closely with the legal, finance, and operations teams during the process.
  • Keep onboarding guidelines (SOPs) updated and look for ways to make processes more efficient.

Requirements:

  • This position is open to graduates whose graduation dates fall between November 2025 and October 2026.
  • Good English communication for the daily work and contact with foreign team.
  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and process discipline.
  • Experience in logistics, delivery platforms, or shared economy operations is a strong plus.
  • Experience with data analytic tools such as SQL or similar tools.
  • Organization and proactivity, with a great willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join Keeta, a member of Meituan, one of the largest global technology companies shaping the future of delivery, logistics, and local services.
  • Work in a fast-growing business, currently expanding internationally and building its brand in new markets.
  • Gain hands-on experience in recruitment, from sourcing to hiring, in a dynamic, multicultural environment.
  • Work on a team that values mentorship, learning, and innovation on a daily basis.

title: Senior Sales Development Representative
description:
Location: Remote South America (Central Time Zone - USA. 8am - 5pm)

NOTE: Must speak excellent English.

We’re a high-growth recruiting firm trusted by mid-market and venture-backed companies to deliver top-tier talent in Technology, Product Management, and Executive Search. Our model spans contract, contract-to-hire, and direct hire placements, offering clients flexibility, speed, and culture-aligned hiring solutions.

Our sales team is the tip of the spear. We're looking for a Senior Sales Development Representative to help us accelerate growth by setting qualified meetings with decision-makers at fast-moving companies.

The Role

As a Senior SDR, you’ll be responsible for creating high-quality opportunities for our Managing Director through proactive outbound outreach across multiple channels. Your mission: generate meaningful conversations with hiring leaders at mid-market companies (100–5,000 employees) across the U.S.

This role is high-volume, phone-led, and metrics-driven—best suited for someone who thrives in a high-energy environment and knows how to position consulting services in a competitive market.

What You'll Do

  • Own the top of the funnel for all outbound activity across phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Research and segment leads using ZoomInfo, Crelate, and LinkedIn Premium
  • Execute 100 –120+ cold calls/day, plus daily targeted emails and LinkedIn messaging
  • Book qualified meetings with decision-makers (typically VPs, Directors, and Founders)
  • Track activity and pipeline through SourceWhale and internal CRM systems
  • Partner closely with the Managing Director to ensure meeting quality and ICP alignment
  • Iterate and improve outreach campaigns based on performance metrics and conversion data

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5+ years of SDR experience in a B2B consulting or staffing/recruiting environment
  • Proven success generating meetings with mid-market U.S. clients
  • Mastery of cold calling and sales engagement tools (SourceWhale, ZoomInfo, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of professional services, especially in technology, product, or executive search
  • Confident, curious, and motivated by the challenge of breaking into new accounts
  • Comfortable with high daily activity targets and KPI-driven accountability
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

What You’ll Get

  • Base salary + bonuses with uncapped earning potential
  • Daily mentorship from a Managing Director with deep industry experience
  • Flexible, remote-first work culture with outcome-driven autonomy
  • Access to best-in-class tools to power your outreach and workflow
  • Opportunity to grow into a full-cycle sales or account management role

title: NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager - LATAM
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering cutting-edge sequencing technologies and advancing life sciences research worldwide. We are dedicated to enabling affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding our impact across the Americas. If you’re passionate about genomics, NGS, and making a real difference in healthcare and research, join us on this exciting journey toward accessible innovation for all.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM to lead our Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Bioinformatics, Quality, and Customer Experience teams across Latin America. This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.
  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team including Field Application Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Field Bioinformaticians, and Customer Support professionals.
  • Oversee customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, ensuring that service requests, installations, and technical issues are managed effectively and within expected timelines.
  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.
  • Able to support and coordinate teams across the LATAM time zones.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Strong academic background or work experience in NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) is highly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, field service, or applications management, ideally within the genomics or life sciences industry.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding technical and scientific teams.
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities; capable of navigating global structures and driving results across functions.
  • Willingness to travel regionally and internationally, including occasional training or collaboration trips to China.

PAY RANGE AND COMPENSATION PACKAGE

MGI offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to employees and their dependents (including domestic partners), which includes:

  • Medical and dental coverage
  • Travel insurance
  • Meal vouchers
  • Gym allowance

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

MGI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: On-Site IT Support Engineer

Location : Sao paulo Brazil (Onsite)

Duration : 3 months Contract (extendable)

Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.

Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.

Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.

Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.

Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.

Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.

Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.

Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.

Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.

Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.

Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.

Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.

Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

Com mais de 300 profissionais que chamamos de Secpowers espalhados em todo o Brasil e temos escritórios em Brasília (DF), Cuiabá (MT), Curitiba (PR), Fortaleza (CE), Goiânia (GO), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP), estamos em constante expansão.

Reconhecidos 3 vezes pelo Great Place to WorkTM, temos uma cultura forte, baseada em inovação, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade e respeito.

Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, essa vaga pode ser sua!

Essa posição é para o profissional compor o time do Security Center como DevSecOps em Brasília, DF.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Neste papel, você vai atuar principalmente no desenvolvimento de APIs, automações, integração de sistemas e esteiras CI/CD, com foco em performance, confiabilidade e boas práticas de segurança.

Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolvimento e Automação
  • Criar e manter APIs, serviços e ferramentas internas voltadas para automação de processos de TI e segurança;
  • Construir e manter pipelines CI/CD eficientes e reutilizáveis com foco em agilidade e rastreabilidade;
  • Desenvolver integrações com sistemas internos e externos (ex: plataformas de monitoramento, bancos de dados, serviços em nuvem);
  • Automatizar tarefas com scripts e workflows (Python, Node.js, Shell, etc.);
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e colaborar com o time de engenharia em melhorias de arquitetura.
  • Garantir que as esteiras CI/CD incluam validações básicas de segurança (SAST, secret scanning, lint, etc.);
  • Apoiar no controle de acesso e autenticação entre serviços (OAuth2, JWT, API Keys, etc.);
  • Auxiliar na implementação de práticas seguras no ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex: validação de entrada, logs estruturados, gestão de segredos);
  • Colaborar pontualmente com times de segurança na integração de ferramentas e coleta de evidências para auditoria ou resposta a incidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Análise e desenvolvimento de sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento back end (ex: Python, Node.js, Go ou similares);
  • Conhecimento sólido em construção de pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Vivência com containers (Docker), Kubernetes, e versionamento com Git;
  • Familiaridade com automação de tarefas e integração de APIs;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais ou NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com sistema operacional Linux e Virtualização.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Conhecimentos básicos de segurança em aplicações web (OWASP, autenticação segura, etc.);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação como Ansible, Terraform ou similares;
  • Noções de práticas DevOps/SRE: observabilidade, logging estruturado;
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de gestão de segredos (Vault, Doppler, AWS Secrets Manager).

E aí, deu match!? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time de secpowers!

title: Financial Analyst
description:
This is a dynamic role that involves navigating through various responsibilities within the Finance department. The ideal candidate should be able to cover for employees during vacation periods and maternity leave, and eventually, by mid-next year, assume a Finance Analyst role responsible for Sales Invoices and Accounts Payable.

We are looking for someone willing to lead and execute a project to automate our accounts payable process by implementing CNAB file usage (the system already supports this functionality). During this transition period, the candidate will gain experience across different areas of the Finance organization, which will strengthen their knowledge and prepare them to take on the main responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Receive daily picking lists from Logistics, insert selected serial numbers into the system, verify item balances and weight distribution, and input transportation and other outbound data.
  • Register invoices with the government, issue them to customers, and send product quality certificates.
  • Create various invoice types: consignments, alternate delivery addresses, industrialization, branch transfers, and exports.
  • Weekly, handle fiscal appointments related to issued invoices, including customer communication and issuing correction letters or other adjustments.
  • Compare weekly DDA-bank data with system records to ensure all open items are posted and approved.
  • Generate and send one weekly payment file to the bank, process the return file, and reconcile posted amounts.
  • Twice a month, organize intercompany international payments, perform cash flow analysis, gather documentation, send to the bank, and register payments.
  • Support month-end closing by reconciling accounts such as stock, intercompany payables, and imports in transit.

Required:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Accountant or other related areas.
  • Advanced English.
  • Excel skills.
  • Knowledge of accounts payable, invoicing, or accounting processes.

Desirable:

  • Experience working with SAP B1.
  • Speak Spanish (intermediate level).
  • Experience working with CNAB files.

title: Customer Support Technician (Hardware & Software)
description:
Are you a proactive technical support professional with a passion for medical aesthetic technology?

Quartier Latin is a rapidly expanding importer and distributor of cutting-edge medical aesthetic equipment in Brazil, and we are in an exciting phase of growth! Following the consolidated success of our 2D/3D imaging camera and its analysis software, we have expanded our portfolio with the addition of an advanced cryolipolysis device.

We are looking for a versatile Customer Support Technician to join our team in São Paulo, SP, Brazil. This is a crucial position responsible for providing specialized technical assistance, training, and maintenance for both our advanced 2D/3D analysis systems and our new cryolipolysis devices. You will be a key player in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our customers across Brazil and Latin America.

What You'll Do:

  • Provide comprehensive technical support (remote and, when necessary, on-site) for the 2D/3D imaging software (installation, calibration, analysis) and for the cryolipolysis equipment (operation, fault diagnosis, repairs).
  • Perform practical diagnostics, troubleshooting, and basic to intermediate level maintenance/repairs on hardware components, especially for cryolipolysis devices.
  • Manage software licenses and updates, guiding customers on new functionalities.
  • Collaborate with the Supply Chain department for repair estimates and warranty management.
  • Interface with Marketing, Sales, Production, and R&D teams to provide valuable customer feedback and contribute to continuous product improvement.
  • Develop and deliver product training for customers and distributors.
  • Create and update technical documentation (user manuals, FAQs, troubleshooting guides).
  • Report bugs and critical field information to the Research and Development department.

What We're Looking For:

Essential Experience:

  • Technical Degree completed (technical courses/degrees in Electronics, Mechatronics, IT, Automation, or related fields are a plus).
  • Minimum of 2 years of proven experience in technical support, ideally with electronic equipment and/or specific software.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) is mandatory for communication with our headquarters in France and global partners.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for both software and hardware.
  • Ability to perform hands-on diagnostics and basic to intermediate level repairs.

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in the medical aesthetic industry.
  • Fluent Spanish (written and spoken) will be a significant advantage for supporting our customer base in Latin America.

Personal Attributes:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Empathy, patience, and calmness under pressure.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and highly organized.
  • Strong reading comprehension and active listening skills.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a rapidly expanding company at the forefront of medical aesthetic technology.
  • Work with innovative products and a dedicated team.
  • Opportunity to make a significant impact on customer success and product evolution.
  • Dynamic and collaborative work environment.

Location: São Paulo, SP, Brazil.

title: Senior Back End Developer
description:
We are building the world's greatest community of remote technologists.

Organizations that embrace remote work gain access to the brightest minds across the globe. Our clients rely on our community to build or expand their teams with best-in-class remote software engineers, designers, and Agile practitioners—rapidly deployed without compromising on quality.

Join our Remobi community to work on meaningful, innovative freelance projects and help shape how companies operate.

Senior Backend Developer (NestJS / Digital Banking Platform)

We are seeking a Senior Backend Developer with 10+ years of experience and deep expertise in NestJS, API architecture, and multi-tenant systems to join our team. You will lead backend development for a next-generation digital banking platform, enabling account creation, secure transfers, real-time dashboards, and deposit tracking.

This is a hands-on leadership role for an engineer who thrives in fast-paced environments, challenges assumptions, and mentors a young and ambitious engineering team while driving backend excellence.

Backend Development & Architecture

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable multi-tenant APIs for a digital banking system.
  • Implement secure account creation, transfers, and real-time banking dashboards.
  • Lead API architecture discussions, testing (unit, integration, e2e), and deployments.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor and coach a growing engineering team, instilling best practices in backend systems.
  • Facilitate code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Challenge existing approaches and propose better architectural and technical solutions.

Event Streaming & Observability

  • Drive the adoption of event streaming (Kafka) for real-time transaction processing.
  • Implement strong monitoring, logging, and observability with tools such as Datadog or Grafana.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with frontend engineers (React/Next.js, React Native) to deliver seamless banking experiences.
  • Contribute to onboarding processes by setting up tools, frameworks, and engineering standards.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders to ensure reliable and timely delivery.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in backend development.
  • Deep expertise with NestJS (architecture, testing, and production deployment).
  • Strong background in multi-tenant API systems and scalable backend architectures.
  • Experience in financial services or digital banking is highly desirable.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Knowledge of observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana.
  • Strong leadership, mentoring, and coaching skills.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Spanish.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil.   • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.

  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

title: Representante de Vendas - Exclusivo para PCD (Brasil)
description:
Descrição do cargo:

Chiesi Brasil

A Chiesi Brasil tem mais de 45 anos de história dedicados à produção de medicamentos de última geração, com qualidade e confiabilidade reconhecidas mundialmente. Foi a primeira afiliada da Chiesi e é atualmente entre as 10 maiores operações do Grupo. Contamos com uma planta industrial localizada em Santana de Parnaíba, que abastece o mercado interno e exporta para diversos países do Grupo, além de uma sede administrativa em São Paulo e uma Força de Campo distribuída pelo país. São mais de 400 colaboradores atuando diariamente com foco na melhora da qualidade de vida dos pacientes. Como uma empresa que vive diariamente uma cultura centrada em pessoas, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa Great Place to Work, e de ter feito parte do ranking das 20 melhores empresas de saúde para trabalhar no Brasil em 2024. Nós fomos a primeira empresa do mercado farmacêutico brasileiro a receber a certificação ISO 37001, que visa apoiar as organizações no combate à corrupção, e é mais uma demonstração da nossa forma de atuar com transparência para o mercado e a sociedade, fortalecendo nossa credibilidade junto a colaboradores, clientes e parceiros. Tudo isso graças à nossa cultura de transparência, empatia, colaboração e foco nas pessoas!

Unidade AIR

A Chiesi está totalmente comprometida com o cuidado e a melhoria da qualidade de vida de pessoas que sofrem de doenças respiratórias, incluindo asma e DPOC (Doença Pulmonar Obstrutiva Crônica).

Propósito

Desenvolver as atividades de promoção médica dos produtos da unidade de negócios Primary Care (Franquia AIR) da empresa, baseando-se nas características e benefícios demonstrados pelos estudos clínicos e conhecimentos médico-científicos, através de visitas e reuniões com médicos, clínicas, hospitais e farmácias; com o objetivo de atingir as metas estabelecidas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Visitar médicos e eventualmente profissionais de saúde em consultórios, clínicas, hospitais e serviços públicos de saúde, objetivando divulgar e promover os produtos da empresa;
  • Elaborar e executar Plano de Ação Territorial e Tático, com base nas estratégicas da empresa;
  • Promover encontros e reuniões junto aos médicos e/ou profissionais de saúde com o intuito de estimular o debate e a troca de informações médico-científicas, viabilizando uma melhor divulgação, experimentação e prescrição dos produtos da empresa;
  • Planejar e organizar o trabalho de visitação médica para melhor desenvolvimento das atividades de trabalho e bom nível de produtividade em campo, alcançando os KPIs (indicadores de performance) da empresa;
  • Manter eficiência no levantamento de dados dos médicos, hospitais, clínicas, através de coleta de informações e preparação de dados, reportando nos sistemas da empresa visando enriquecimento, atualização e acompanhamento de cadastro médico da empresa;
  • Analisar as ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa, para ter total conhecimento do comportamento dos seus produtos frente a concorrência, para melhor atuação;
  • Visitar com frequência farmácias, drogarias e redes, para monitorar a demanda, estoque e ações dos produtos da empresa e da concorrência;
  • Utilizar as técnicas de Direção Defensiva na condução do veículo da empresa em todos os momentos e situações;
  • Atender as diretrizes do Código de Ética e de Conduta, Política Antissuborno e demais políticas e procedimentos do Programa de Integridade da Chiesi.

Experiência requerida

  • Formação superior completa. Preferencialmente em Administração, Comunicação, Marketing, Farmácia, Biomedicina ou afins;
  • CNH válida e disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Experiência comercial na indústria farmacêutica (medicamentos, equipamentos, soluções, etc).
  • Experiência préviae na linha respiratório ou cardiovascular será diferencial

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30k BRL

Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.

Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  • Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  • Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  • System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  • Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  • Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

title: Client Services Coordinator
description:
Client Services Coordinator

Role Overview: A Leadership Role in Strategic Talent Acquisition

The Client Services Coordinator is a pivotal, client-facing leadership role that sits at the intersection of client management, operational excellence, and strategic talent acquisition. You will be the primary operational and strategic partner for a dedicated portfolio of clients utilizing our Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO).

This position is about driving performance: ensuring compliance, leading a team of recruiters, optimizing the full recruitment lifecycle, and managing the financial health of your client accounts. You will be instrumental in building long-term client trust while delivering measurable results and introducing innovative recruitment strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities fall into three core areas: Client & Strategy Management, Team & Process

Leadership, and Operational & Financial Control.

1. Client & Strategy Management

  • Strategic Partnership: Serve as the primary point of contact and strategic partner, cultivating deep, long-term trust with clients, hiring managers, and internal recruiters.
  • Solution Delivery: Develop and execute strategies for RPO and MSP solutions, proactively anticipating client needs and introducing new and innovative recruitment and selection concepts.
  • Stakeholder Satisfaction: Increase satisfaction for both internal clients (Hiring Managers) and candidates by designing and overseeing structured selection processes with consistent communication and feedback.
  • Transparent Reporting: Ensure a positive, transparent relationship through regular weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews to present results, propose new strategies, and discuss performance.

2. Team & Process Leadership

  • Full-Cycle Management: Own and manage the entire recruitment process for a portfolio of accounts, often focused on filling niche, challenging, and specialized positions.
  • Recruiter Leadership: Directly lead, manage, and develop a team of recruiters and researchers, providing constant feedback and structured development plans.
  • Process Improvement: Drive continuous improvement in selection execution by evaluating and integrating new recruitment technologies and tools.
  • Recruiter Support: Provide proactive, hands-on support to the team in candidate sourcing efforts and overcoming roadblocks.

3. Operational & Financial Control

  • Performance Monitoring: Directly manage and control Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all accounts through robust control and monitoring methodologies.
  • Data & Insights: Build and maintain operational dashboards and vacancy spreadsheets, ensuring data accuracy and facilitating clear communication across all stakeholders.
  • Financial Health: Ensure the financial performance of the client contract portfolio by managing Gross Profit (GP) and Operating Expenses (Opex).

Candidate Requirements

Experience & Education

  • Minimum Experience: A minimum of 5 years of professional experience is required.
  • Leadership/Specialist Experience: Proven experience in a leadership, senior specialist, or similar high-level role is highly valued.
  • Preferred Industry Background: Experience in a multinational company is preferred. Experience in Pharmaceutical, Medical Devices, or Life Sciences is a plus but not mandatory.
  • Education: Completed Higher Education (University Degree) is mandatory.

Skills & Technical Expertise

1. Core Capabilities (Dominant/Expert Knowledge Required)

  • Recruitment & Selection (R&S): Expert-level, hands-on knowledge of full-cycle recruiting processes, strategies, and best practices.
  • Data & Metrics Management: Strong experience in building and utilizing operational dashboards and key recruitment metrics (KPIs/SLAs) for control, monitoring, and strategic decision-making.
  • Computer Skills (Office Suite): Expert-level proficiency in Excel (for data analysis and reporting), PowerPoint (for strategic presentations), Word, and Outlook.

2. Strategic & Leadership Skills (Strong Proficiency Required)

  • Operational & Process Leadership: Proven ability to lead and develop people, manage complex demand cycles, and drive overall process efficiency.
  • Client Management: Strong skill set in managing relationships, fostering long-term trust, and presenting business reviews and proposals to key stakeholders.

Location, Compensation, & Language

Compensation

  • Salary Range: R9,5000–R11,000 (Gross Monthly Salary).
  • Note: This figure is dependent on experience and is subject to internal benchmarking.

Location & Language Requirements

This role is based in Brazil and requires specific language proficiencies for client-facing and strategic communication:

  • Location: Must reside in or near São Paulo, Brazil.
  • Portuguese: Required (Proficient or Native fluency).
  • English: Required (Advanced or Business Fluency for strategic client and internal communication).
  • Spanish: Basic proficiency is considered a distinct advantage.

description:
VEM SER NOSSA PESSOA SUPERVISORA DE CALÇADOS E ENTRAR NO NOSSO JOGO!

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

Tem habilidade para liderar e inspirar? Esta vaga é para você! Você vai treinar e engajar a equipe, garantir um atendimento top e cuidar da gestão do estoque, levando nosso time a marcar golaços todos os dias.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Você será responsável por executar e garantir a execução dos processos de venda do setor de calçados, prestando atendimento de qualidade e zelando pela satisfação do cliente, conforme nosso roteiro de atendimento.

Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Coordenar, acompanhar, treinar e orientar a equipe na realização das tarefas, garantindo que o padrão de atendimento seja seguido, fornecendo feedback diários com relação ao atendimento e ao desempenho, visando a melhoria contínua no alcance dos resultados.
  • Efetuar a gestão de estoque do setor, analisando o desempenho dos produtos, visando, assim, propor abertura e/ou adequação dos limites.
  • Realizar conferência qualitativa e quantitativa do setor, garantir que todos os produtos do setor estejam com preços marcados corretamente.
  • Realizar diariamente a reunião com o time e acompanhar o desempenho de acordo com as metas diárias, visando atingir os resultados propostos.
  • Fazer os acompanhamentos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros) com os atletas liderados, de acordo com normas e procedimentos internos.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação

SOBRE A CENTAURO:

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado, afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Sales Account Executive IT
description:
A Inetum é uma empresa global de serviços de TI, reconhecida por sua agilidade, inovação e compromisso com a transformação digital. Presente em mais de 29 países e com uma equipe de cerca de 28.000 colaboradores apaixonados e altamente qualificados, a Inetum alcançou uma receita de 2,3 bilhões de euros em 2023, consolidando sua posição como parceira confiável na entrega de soluções tecnológicas de alto impacto.

Com um portfólio diversificado e alinhado às necessidades do futuro, a empresa busca profissionais talentosos para integrar sua equipe de vendas no Brasil, com foco em soluções de TI nas seguintes áreas:

  • SAP: Implementação, upgrades, migrações, suporte contínuo, Business Intelligence (BI), análise de dados, auditoria e compliance.
  • Segurança Cibernética: Avaliação de riscos, proteção de dados, gestão de identidade e acessos, testes de penetração e simulação de ataques, além de soluções de privacidade e conformidade regulatória.
  • Digital: Análise de dados avançada (Data Science), Business Intelligence (BI), desenvolvimento de software customizado (web e mobile), automação de processos e integração de sistemas.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: Planejamento e implementação de soluções de infraestrutura, gerenciamento de redes e servidores, e monitoramento de ambientes de TI críticos.

Estamos em busca de profissionais com um perfil dinâmico, que compartilhem nossa paixão por tecnologia e inovação. Se você possui excelentes habilidades de comunicação, empatia para entender as necessidades dos clientes, foco em resultados e uma visão estratégica para oferecer soluções disruptivas e de longo prazo, você será um grande diferencial para a nossa equipe.

A Inetum oferece um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, com oportunidades contínuas de crescimento profissional e aprendizado.

Se você está pronto para desafiar os limites e fazer a diferença em um cenário digital em constante evolução, essa é a oportunidade ideal.

Junte-se à Inetum e seja parte de um time que está sempre à frente do seu tempo, transformando o futuro com soluções tecnológicas de ponta!

Local: São Paulo Região da Berrini e Rio de Janeiro Centro Rio Branco

Modelo Hibrido: 2x na semana ou quando necessário

Desejável: Inglês para conversação

title: Especialista financeiro
description:
Especialista Financeiro

Atuará em concessão de Infra Social no munícipio de São Paulo

  • Manter o modelo econômico-financeiro da concessão atualizado (Plano de Negócios, contemplando Balanço Patrimonial, Demonstração de Resultado, Fluxo de Caixa, Valuation, entre outros indicadores);
  • Acompanhar orçado vs. realizado, explicar variações, revisar premissas e propor ações corretivas;

  • Apoiar no cumprimento de obrigações contratuais e no atendimento a agentes reguladores;
  • Apoiar áreas internas com análises financeiras ad hoc e contribuir para o processo de tomada de decisão;
  • Sugerir e implementar melhorias em processos financeiros e controles internos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Economia, Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia relevante em planejamento financeiro e modelagem econômica/financeira;

title: Data Scientist
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que aderir à TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado e cheia de oportunidades de melhoria e desenvolvimento mútuo. O(a) profissional será responsável por explorar, analisar e modelar grandes volumes de dados, aplicando técnicas estatísticas e de machine learning.

  • Conhecimento em SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados.
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento e validação de modelos de machine learning.
  • Manipulação de grandes volumes.
  • Conhecimento básico em computação em nuvem.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

  • Accounting
  • Part-time, Contract (approx. 20 hours per week)
  • Location: Remote

WHAT IF...

You could help an entire industry become more efficient with technology? At PickTrace, we are digitizing the agriculture industry in a big way, and that’s why we are looking for an Implementations Specialist to join our Implementations team.

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Senior Accountant or Accounting Manager to join our team on a part-time basis (approximately 20 hours per week). The ideal candidate will be experienced in QuickBooks Online (QBO), Excel, and all core aspects of monthly accounting close processes.

This role will report directly to the Controller. This role will be fully remote.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Weekly

  • Manage the full Accounts Receivable (AR) cycle:
  • Receive and process client agreements
  • Generate and send 10–20 invoices weekly
  • Maintain AR schedule and support collections (handle complex invoicing schedules)
  • Oversee the full Accounts Payable (AP) cycle:
  • Receive and process vendor bills
  • Route invoices for approval
  • Dispute or follow up on payments when necessary (Bill.com experience preferred)
  • Perform weekly bank reconciliations
  • Assist with credit card and expense report reconciliation (15 corporate cards, 2 bank accounts)
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Internal Operations, and other teams as needed

Monthly

  • Execute a timely and accurate month-end close (by the 18th of each month), including:
  • Bank reconciliations
  • Prepaid expense schedules
  • Accruals and deferrals
  • Depreciation and amortization schedules
  • Expense reclassifications
  • Identification and analysis of revenue leakage
  • Assist with the preparation of monthly financial statements

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Proficient in English (written and verbal)
  • Proven experience in accounting and month-end close processes
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Excel
  • Familiarity with Bill.com is a plus
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently and communicate effectively across teams

WORK SCHEDULE

  • Approximately 20 hours per week
  • Availability required 3 times per week between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM Pacific Time during the initial ramp-up period

title: Gerente de Vendas | Caminhões Sanitários
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2. Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. E

m 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano estratégico de vendas para o portfólio de Caminhões Sanitários;
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos, assegurando a satisfação do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e novas demandas, analisando concorrência, tendências e potencial de clientes;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos com stakeholders do setor;
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais, apresentações de produtos e negociação de propostas comerciais;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de engenharia, pós-vendas e operações para garantir soluções técnicas adequadas e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área comercial (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem, rentabilidade e forecast;
  • Participar de feiras, eventos e fóruns do setor portuário e logístico para promover a marca e gerar novos negócios.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas, preferencialmente no setor de Caminhões Sanitários;
  • Atuação prévia com negociações complexas (grandes contas, projetos sob medida, contratos de longo prazo);
  • Vivência no relacionamento com clientes B2B e na gestão de ciclo de vendas consultivo;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e pacote Office.
